description:
Due 2026-11-07. OpenAI web search through the gateway (or Responses API tool), results filtered by a per-run blocklist (TC leak control, ANVIL-21). Used by cra-review (current CRA guidance) and investigate.

## Acceptance

A query that would hit gitlab.rtems.org returns no result from that domain; a CRA query returns cited sources.

comments.body: [claude] Key correction: the leak-control story is ANVIL-22 (not ANVIL-21).

[claude] PR https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/11 (review: devin). OpenAI web search via gateway; blocklist checks opened + cited URLs, retries once, then withholds the whole result. Live test passed (CRA Annex I with eur-lex citations). Wiring into the executor's tools follows on #8.
